The DP state best_ending_here[i] adds the optimal subproblem best_ending_here[j] to the arithmetic sequence sum of length m = min(books[i], i - j). The solution runs in O(n) time and O(n) space; no candidate is required.

The condition books[j] - j < books[i] - i accurately identifies the previous shelf where the capacity constraint forces a tighter bound than the maximal descending arithmetic sequence from shelf i.
Each shelf index is pushed and popped at most once from the monotonic stack, taking O(n) overall time and O(n) space for the DP array and stack. Complexity evidence is inherited and hash-bound.
